title: 第一卷 第330章 周家账单
slug: 纨绔世子爷公主退婚我造反
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陈炎低头看他。

“惊不惊喜？”

周绍嘴巴张了张。

没声了。

陈炎把身契递给白芷。

“拿着。”

白芷看着那张纸，没接。

她像是不敢信。

陈炎说道：“别愣着。”

“这玩意儿你拿了，就自由了。”

白芷伸手接过。

手有点不稳。

她看着陈炎，忽然跪下。

陈炎赶紧往旁边躲。

“别跪。”

Page (1/3)

Chen Yan looked down at him.

"Are you surprised?"

Zhou Shao opened his mouth.

There was no sound.

Chen Yan handed the body deed to Bai Zhi.

"Take it."

Bai Zhi looked at the piece of paper and didn't take it.

She seemed like she couldn't believe it.

Chen Yan said: "Don't be stunned."

"If you take this thing, you will be free."

Bai Zhi reached out and took it.

My hands are a little unsteady.

She looked at Chen Yan and suddenly knelt down.

Chen Yan quickly hid aside.

"Don't kneel."
